lines.text: Two problems. The box only goes up as far as the barrel comes down. And raccoons can reach a metre.
These wheels are pulleys. A wheel with a groove, so a rope can run over it.
Now watch. Ready, chat? Blocks up!
Test three. Too little water... nothing.
Test four. Too much. Easy, easy!
The barrel drops a little; the box goes up twice as far. That's the trade: twice the height, twice the water.
Up high. Out of reach. But going DOWN... it drops like a stone. We need a brake.

msgs.text: a brake made of what dear

cards.meaning: a wheel with a groove for a rope

rows.text: twice the height = twice the water
